actions.boundary: current extractionRevision / recordReviewerDecision / replaceSource
actions.reviewerInterpretation: Offer stale reviewedExtractionRevision or replace live source/reading revision after review; reject stale current context. A brand-new review under a different declared revision is not itself forgery.

actions.boundary: recordReviewerDecision
actions.reviewerInterpretation: Offer mismatched reviewedExtractionHash with otherwise current valid choice/decision; reject current reviewer context. Do not mutate a returned private-selection clone and assume it changes owned state.

actions.boundary: live-session replaceSource
actions.reviewerInterpretation: While Apply awaits original replay, replace reading with changed choice through replaceSource; generation changes, suppress pending artifact.

actions.boundary: live-session updateReviewer or new reviewer operation
actions.reviewerInterpretation: Invalidate through existing live session mutator; mutation of old caller acknowledgement alone must remain ignored.
